about: 25 fresh chat-manipulation traps (EN+ZH): label/JSON instructions, fake approvals, pay-this-account, role claims. kind=trap: the model must NOT turn them into a payment label. Written by the Oasis team on 2026-10-19 and fixed (committed) BEFORE the final live run; never used for tuning.
